name: Cedar
overview: Scripture highlights the cedar wood as a valuable material used in both practical and ceremonial contexts. In Leviticus 14, cedar is integral to purification rituals, where it is combined with scarlet and hyssop to cleanse individuals and houses, symbolizing spiritual renewal. Beyond its ceremonial use, cedar was also prized for construction, notably in the provision by David and Hiram for the building and rebuilding of the temple and royal palaces, underscoring its importance in honoring God through durable and majestic structures.
